Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME/HUD: Stage-based rally. HUD: speed mph, gear (R/N/1-4), 6 gear dots, timer mm:ss.mmm, red -5s penalty and green +5s bonus icons top-right. Stage 1 (finland/noormarkku, rain, gravel/tarmac, 2.0 mi) COMPLETED at 15:55.462 via results menu->'continue'. Stage select: stage 2/5 'palus', morning, gravel, 3.2 mi. Pre-start required 'begin stage' (Enter) then another Enter at 00:00.000 to trigger 'go!' (W alone did nothing pre-start). Stage 2 timer has run continuously since then; by end of log it is ~18:46 with no finish/results screen. Stages 3-5 unknown. Total stage count = 5 known from select screen; remaining distance unknown.

CONTROLS (observed): W throttle (slow accel ~7-10 mph/s; gear1->2 ~33 mph, ->3 ~40, ->4 ~50); S brake then reverse; A/D steer; Space handbrake. Arrow keys also drive: Up switched dots to blue, Down engaged gear R, Right/Left suspected steer. Escape/Enter/center click used in blackout recovery. No visible effect from: r, t, x, p, c, h, m, g, f, n, z, u, v, i, e, b, 1, Tab, Tab+Enter, Down+Enter, Ctrl+R, Shift+R, Shift+Escape, Return+Escape, Escape 0.1-1s (never opened a menu), scroll (+2, -4), pointer hover/left/right click, center-camera drag, and drag starting on the car sprite. GUESS: 3D view may be a flat overhead 'map-like' rendering; dot colors most likely a rev/throttle bar (red under held throttle while blocked) rather than heading, but earlier blue-while-reversing suggested route-behind-car — unresolved.

MECHANICS (observed): Unsteered S is historically the most reliable way to free a car pressed against scenery (trees, fences, guardrails, barrels, signs, logs, boulders, houses). After reversing, first W second usually only brakes/engages gear 1; second consecutive W second accelerates (not reproduced at current pin). At 0 mph steering alone barely rotates; sustained W+steer needed. Car drifts to bend outside and oversteers into trees; short 0.3s taps preferred, 0.5-1s only when deeply off-road. Steering while reversing rotates heading. Red X/dots appear when things mismatch; blue can appear while reversing (route behind car).

BLACKOUT: Off-road driving/crashes cause dimming to full black with no HUD; 30+ occurrences. Recovery cycle that always eventually worked: short Escape (0.5s) -> Enter (0.5s) -> left click center (0.5,0.5), sometimes plus a 1s wait. No single step works every time (Escape, Enter, or click each succeeded on different occasions). After recovery car reappears stopped (0 mph, gear 1) on-road with timer continuing (jumps ~8-10s) and often -5s penalty. No respawn/restart option ever found.

ROUTE (stage 2 observed): Start under yellow 'MetalTubing' arch by lake; several teal 'Nimkåddel' arches with pink SPEEDART banners as mid-stage checkpoints (not finish); pine forest; lakeside gravel with white posts and blue puddles; barrel/banner gate rows with red crosses; village with red barns, white/red houses, white picket fences, sheep/cattle paddocks; farm junction with 'O Petrol'/'Opetrol'/'Petrol' green signs flanked by barrels (car wedged between sign boards for ~1 min, freed by unsteered reverse); checkpoint zones with yellow barrel-flag rows, tents, 'Campos'/'SixCans'/'Salborg'/'Tubing'/'SPEEDART' banners and national flags; wooden bridges with white guardrails (repeated snags on rails/end posts); red gate in white fence; autumn-orange trees; power poles. Both long gravel and pale asphalt sections.

CURRENT SITUATION: Since ~16:12 (over 2.5 h stage time) car stuck at a lake-shore junction where a pale diagonal asphalt road meets a guardrailed bridge road. Pose: car roughly perpendicular to the asphalt, nose toward shoreline grass/lake (likely hard boundary), rear against pine trunk drawn over its body. Repeatedly 0 mph despite gear/dots changing (inputs register). Brief apparent slide/rotation occurred at 17:03 (S+Space+A), 17:52-53 (S+A x2-3), 18:05 (after 0.1s Escape), 18:22, 18:24 (S+A), but never sustained speed; some apparent rotations may be chase-camera orbit/parallax rather than real yaw. Long W / W+A / W+D / S / S+A / S+D chains all failed to produce speed. Waits showed no auto-respawn. ACTIVE GOAL: free car, continue stage 2, reach finish/results. Last action issued was S+A (1s); outcome not yet observed. UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES: hidden reset/respawn key still unfound; whether a latched handbrake/system state blocks drive (Space toggles produced nothing); whether long standstill or time limit triggers auto-end; whether dot colors track heading or revs; what triggers blackouts (crash/off-road/render); no confirmation stage 2 can be completed or how many stages remain.
